description: This file defines an Angular component for managing schedules within a frontend application. It includes UI templates for listing, creating, editing, and deleting schedule items, along with associated logic for interacting with an API service.

classes.name: SchedulesPageComponent
classes.description: Angular component responsible for displaying and managing scheduling data, including listing, editing, creating, and deleting schedule entries.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook called upon component initialization; loads schedule data.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of schedules from the API and populates the schedules list.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares the form with data from a selected schedule for editing.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the form to default values for creating a new schedule.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Submits form data to create or update a schedule via API.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a selected schedule after user confirmation.
